text:
Maria Chen: quick q — the new redis-memory-high alert flared during the staging deploy. Where's the canonical place to look for the traces/metrics? I only see the Grafana panel but the alert payload didn't include the trace link.

Kevin Ortiz: couple places to check quickly:
- Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/redis/redis-overview (panel: memory usage)
- Traces (Jaeger): https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=redis
- Logs (Kibana): https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/?index=redis-logs-*
The alert payload should include a dashboard link but the current alert rule is missing the trace url.

Maria Chen: thanks. Also question about routing — currently the alert pages to app-oncall only. Should we add infra-oncall as a fallback (e.g., after 2m) when memory stays > 90%? We had a noisy one that needed infra help during the deploy.

Samir Patel: +1 on adding a fallback. We've had confusion about ownership. Proposal: escalate to infra-oncall after 2m of sustained >90% memory, and add a deploy suppression label so planned deploy noise doesn't wake people.

Kevin Ortiz: process notes: update the PagerDuty escalation policy for the redis service (service name: redis-cluster-prod). You can edit via the PD web UI or API. Example API sketch:```bash
curl -X PUT "https://api.pagerduty.com/escalation_policies/EP123" \
  -H "Authorization: Token token=$PD_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "escalation_policy": {
      "escalation_rules": [
        /* existing rules */, 
        {"escalation_delay_in_minutes": 2, "targets": [{"id": "PDSCHED_INfra", "type": "schedule_reference"}]}
      ]
    }
  }'
```Or use pdctl if you have it: `pd escalation-policy update EP123 --add-rule "2m->PDSCHED_INfra"`.
Also: add a suppression window in Alertmanager by annotating alerts with `suppress:deploy` during deploy jobs (CI will set that label), and add a matcher in the alertmanager config to drop matching alerts during maintenance windows.

Maria Chen: where's the runbook for redis memory? I couldn't find it earlier.

Kevin Ortiz: runbook: https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/redis-memory (internal). I also updated the PD service mapping: service id `PDSERVICE_redis_cluster` maps to Slack channel `#oncall-redis`. Check the PD -> Slack integration page if you need to change the channel mapping. If you'd like I can make the PD change after 14:00 UTC (when I'm free).

oncall-bot: Reminder — scheduled maintenance window for redis clusters today 16:00-17:00 UTC. Incidents created during the window will be auto-suppressed per policy. :calendar: :snooze:

Samir Patel: one more ask: can we raise the firing threshold to reduce noise? Current rule is a single-sample >90% which spikes during flushes. Proposal: require avg over 5m > 95% or use `avg_over_time(redis_memory_used_bytes[5m]) / redis_memory_total_bytes > 0.95`.

Maria Chen: that sounds reasonable. Kevin — if you can add the infra fallback and the deploy suppression, I'll open a PR to change the alerting expr to the 5m avg and add the `suppress:deploy` label in the CI job.

Kevin Ortiz: will do. I'll update PD escalation policy + Alertmanager config and post the PD change id and PR links here once done.

Maria Chen: thanks — appreciate it :thumbsup:
